page_title: ROM 2-1 VEN | AS Roma v Venezia 29/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Rosario Abisso ignores the protests.
88' Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
88' Venezia force their opponents to concede a corner.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antonio Raimondo (Venezia) comes onto the pitch so that Joel Pohjanpalo can be given a rest.
85' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Matias Soule and he is replaced by Mario Hermoso (AS Roma).
84' Substitution. Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) in, Antonio Candela out.
83' 2 - 1 Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:1.
83' The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
80' Here is a change. Lorenzo Pellegrini is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Leandro Paredes (AS Roma).
79' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
79' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
77' Substitution. Gaetano Oristanio leaves the pitch and is replaced by Domen Crnigoj (Venezia).
77' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to make a change. Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) replaces Hans Nicolussi Caviglia.
76' Substitution. Issa Doumbia (Venezia) has come on for Mikael Egill Ellertsson.
74' 1 - 1 Goal! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) collected a pass and decided to try his luck from distance. The shot was deflected and it was enough to turn the ball past helpless Jesse Joronen. 1:1.
74' Angelino (AS Roma) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
72' Angelino (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
70' Dangerous play by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma). Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for a foul.
68' The resulting free kick from Matias Soule (AS Roma) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
67' The foul by Antonio Candela (Venezia) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Rosario Abisso.

65' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) is quickest inside the box and leaps to connect with the resulting set piece. He produces a fine header, but it floats just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
65' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) will take the corner.
62' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went way over the bar.
61' The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.

60' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Mile Svilar is alert and denies him with a nice save.
58' Ivan Juric prepares a substitution. Manu Kone is replaced by Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma).
58' Gianluca Mancini comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
58' The linesman signals that Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
57' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) has a goal ruled out for offside!
54' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.

51' Manu Kone (AS Roma) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Jesse Joronen leaps like a salmon to deny him.
48' Matias Soule (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
47' Rosario Abisso blows for a foul after Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Rosario Abisso blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 1 Goal! Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

44' What a great touch by Gianluca Busio (Venezia)! He picks up a precise pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot on goal. His effort, however, only rattles the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
41' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

41' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner.
40' AS Roma couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jesse Joronen (Venezia) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
39' Today's referee Rosario Abisso rightly decides to book Jay Idzes (Venezia) for his harsh tackle.
38' Matias Soule (AS Roma) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
35' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
34' Manu Kone (AS Roma) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Rosario Abisso blows his whistle for an infringement. Venezia have a free kick.

33' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
30' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
27' Venezia work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
26' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
23' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sends a long ball in, but Jesse Joronen comfortably gathers the ball.
19' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) rises above the defence to meet a cross from the corner. His timing is good, but he directs his header just a few inches wide of the left post.
19' AS Roma have a corner.

18' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) controls the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up low in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Jesse Joronen.
16' Rosario Abisso blows the whistle, Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) is penalised for a foul.
14' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
13' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.

9' That was a nice football moment. Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom left corner. Mile Svilar guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
7' An unsuccessful long-range effort by Matias Soule (AS Roma) after he collected a pass and unleashed a shot. The ball was directed under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper made an easy save.
4' Venezia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

3' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Mile Svilar pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the left post. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Venezia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' The free kick is taken by Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia), but ball is cleared.
2' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Rosario Abisso signals a set piece. Venezia are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' The first half has started.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Rosario Abisso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
